form.label: Software & OS inventory
form.description: For a new CVE that Rapid7 has no check for yet: pick the software, OS or network device OS, enter the vulnerable versions from the announcement, and see each Active server's current version (latest VA result), scan freshness and version history. Versions compare segment by segment as numbers. Distro builds (RHEL, Ubuntu) are flagged "Check advisory" because fixes are often backported.

search.query: `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:software)` | eval kind=if(type="Operating System","Operating System","Software") | fields asset_id hostname ip vendor product version type kind cpe last_scan

| search kind="$kind$" | stats dc(asset_id) as devices dc(version) as versions first(vendor) as vendor by product | sort - devices | eval label=product." (".vendor.") · ".devices." devices · ".versions." versions"

| search kind="$kind$" product="$product$" | stats dc(asset_id) as devices first(vendor) as vendor by version | r7vercheck ranges="$ranges$" | sort - in_range - devices | table version devices range_status vendor

`r7_latest(rapid7:vm:software)` product="$product$" | stats first(version) as version first(vendor) as vendor first(cpe) as cpe by asset_id | join type=left asset_id [search `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_site)` | dedup asset_id | fields asset_id hostname ip last_scan site_name] | `r7_cmdb_enrich` | where cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" OR cmdb_status="NOT_IN_CMDB" | search env_label="$env$" | r7vercheck ranges="$ranges$" | eval ls=strptime(replace(last_scan,"Z",""),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), an=if("$announced$"="", now(), strptime("$announced$","%Y-%m-%d")) | eval days_before=round((an-ls)/86400,0), freshness=case(isnull(ls),"None", days_before<=0,"Fresh", days_before<=7,"OK", true(),"Stale: rescan") | join type=left asset_id [search `r7_index` sourcetype="rapid7:vm:software" product="$product$" earliest=-90d | stats min(_time) as first_seen by asset_id version | sort 0 asset_id first_seen | eval h=version." (".strftime(first_seen,"%F").")" | stats list(h) as history by asset_id | eval history=mvjoin(history," → ")] | eval appname=mvjoin(appname,", ") | table hostname ip env_label appname device_category version vendor range_status last_scan days_before freshness history site_name asset_id | sort - in_range env_label hostname

panel.title: Rescan devices to refresh their version

search.query: | search kind="$kind$" product="$product$" | stats first(version) as version first(hostname) as hostname by asset_id | eval label=hostname." · ".version

button.data-r7-confirm: Launch the Rapid7 rescan for the selected devices?

p.span: INACTIVE / DECOMMISSION devices are skipped. Results appear on Scan jobs & reports.

search.query: | r7rescan software=$product|s$ ranges=$ranges|s$ announced=$announced|s$ hosts=$hosts|s$ only_hosts=true scope=all dryrun=true detail=true

| r7rescan software=$product|s$ ranges=$ranges|s$ announced=$announced|s$ hosts=$hosts|s$ only_hosts=true scope=all dryrun=false request_id=$launch_nonce|s$ launched_from="Inventory" reason=$product|s$
